KAS-only /memories controls: saved memory access and automatic-update defaults, plus record browsing (list, preview, detail). Ramped to all internal users on every channel; set treatment_percent to 0 to darken it.

new.description: Autocomplete decoupling cohort: the bundled Toolbox post-install hook asks this flag whether to move a user onto the standalone channel. It does not gate update routing, which always keeps a standalone binary on standalone archives. Starts at 0%; ramp treatment_percent in later releases. Lowering it stops new enrollment but does not move already-migrated users back.
